scope: Static preflight only; no QAOA objective evaluation or benchmark
decision: Do not authorize until the frozen execution environment is available and a non-scientific backend/allocation preflight can verify peak-memory safety. No system settings were changed.

system_safety_guard.minimum_free_memory: must be defined by execution owner before any future run
system_safety_guard.emergency_abort: required on allocation failure or memory pressure
system_safety_guard.disk_safety: preserve output namespace and reject insufficient free space
